objective: Safely expose a tiny verified slice of shadow reflection/memory behavior to the live response-selection path without replacing Primary authority.
runtime_invariants: Primary path remains callable and authoritative throughout the canary
at most one overlay is active
overlay expiration restores Primary-only behavior without migration
same verified input and same state produce deterministic policy decision/hash
no generated goal becomes an external action merely because it was generated
all mutations are limited to the temporary overlay object
no current durable mission packet/lease/control field is changed by runtime overlay evaluation
builder_acceptance: implement canary guard and overlay object
implement before/candidate hash and rollback token
add deterministic tests for identical input
add mutation tests proving base objects remain byte-equivalent
verifier_acceptance: mutate each limit and prove fail-closed
prove Primary works with adapter disabled, expired and faulted
prove at-most-one overlay and TTL rollback
prove no external side effect from generated goals
verify no mission reset/new slot/main write/spend/secret
PASS only authorizes the bounded first canary described by the gate
